blogs.title: Why Large Language Models Still Struggle with Long Texts—and What LongRoPE Changes
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains the context‑window limitation in popular LLMs, why extending it is hard, and how the new LongRoPE technique overcomes these hurdles to reach a 2‑million‑token window.

blogs.title: The Hidden Geometry of RoPE: Understanding Positional Non‑Uniformities
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), the two forms of non‑uniformity discovered by the authors (dimension‑wise and token‑wise), and why treating them differently matters for long‑context performance.

blogs.title: From 4K to 2048K Tokens: The Progressive Fine‑Tuning Strategy Behind LongRoPE
blogs.description: Walks readers through the three‑step progressive extension recipe—search → 256K fine‑tune → second search—that lets a model achieve a 512× context boost with only 1,000 fine‑tuning steps.

blogs.title: Evolutionary Search Meets Transformers: How LongRoPE Finds the Best Positional Scaling
blogs.description: Explains the custom evolutionary algorithm (population seeding, monotonic constraints, mutation/crossover) used to explore billions of RoPE scaling configurations efficiently.

blogs.title: Benchmarks at a Million Tokens: What LongRoPE’s Perplexity and Passkey Tests Reveal
blogs.description: Summarizes the empirical results—perplexity on PG19/Proof‑Pile, passkey retrieval up to 2 M tokens, and standard QA benchmarks—showing that longer context doesn’t sacrifice short‑context accuracy.

blogs.title: Practical Tips for Using LongRoPE Models in Real Applications
blogs.description: Provides a guide for developers: how to load the LongRoPE‑2048K checkpoints, dynamically switch RoPE factors for short inputs, hardware considerations, and example use cases like massive document summarization or very few‑shot prompting.
